title: 市场新高背后：中产信心却亮红灯，为何债券市场参与者更悲观
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Abby, I do want to start off talking about what the market is kind of telling us because we talk about equities, of course, right now, still camped out near record highs.
segments.zh: 艾比，我想先谈谈市场在告诉我们什么，因为我们当然在讨论权益资产，目前仍接近历史高位。

segments.en: But then you look at some of the moves that we've seen in Treasury yields, which seems to suggest, at least among bond investors, that there are a little less sanguine about
segments.zh: 但再看看国债收益率的变动，这似乎表明，至少债券市场参与者对长期前景没那么乐观。

segments.en: the longer term picture. What do we pay most attention to?
What should we? Well, Romaine, you've laid it out quite well in your introductory comments.
segments.zh: 嗯，罗曼，你在开场白中已经说得很好了。

segments.en: Basically, this is an equity market that is being driven, at least for now, by very favorable earnings outlook.
segments.zh: 基本上，这是一个由非常有利的盈利前景驱动的市场，至少目前是这样。

segments.en: We've had great reports, and the expectation is that many of the leading companies will continue to be very profitable, strong margins, strong returns on equity.
segments.zh: 我们看到了很好的报告，预期许多领先公司将继续保持高盈利、强劲的利润率和股本回报率。

segments.en: However, when we look at the rest of the economy, things are looking okay, but not great.
segments.zh: 然而，当我们看经济的其他部分时，情况看起来还行，但不是很好。

segments.en: And that's what those consumer confidence numbers are saying to you.
segments.zh: 这就是消费者信心指数告诉我们的。

segments.en: We basically see, for example, that middle income consumers are not feeling all that great about either their own financial situation or prospective employment and wage gains.
segments.zh: 例如，我们基本上看到，中等收入消费者对自己的财务状况或未来的就业和工资增长感觉不太好。

segments.en: And that's something that's quite telling. Among the things to be looking at, by the way, will be a real-time metric of consumer confidence.
segments.zh: 这很能说明问题。顺便说一句，值得关注的包括消费者信心的实时指标。

segments.en: And that, of course, is consumer spending.
segments.zh: 而这自然就是消费者支出。
